source.title: Firework Launcher
source.objective:
ProgressAlthough rockets are a wonderful way to celebrate, in order to see their glory... they must be fired from a launcher.

Bring me coins of ancestry and I can offer you the knowledge to create rocket launchers like the ones you see in Moonglade.
source.completion: Here you are, <name>.  Here is the schematic to create a firework launcher.  Place launchers where you wish to celebrate, and then welcome your friends to join you!
